applies_why: This judge text does not count a cited verse as an unanswered witness or toward a broken link; it says the rows were answered.
quote: [CR2] G answers the 'almah/bethulah and near-fulfillment rows, leaving the sign's sense open.
rule_words: A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count. A verse the judge counts toward a broken link is counted this way. A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.
why: The judge text treats the rows as answered and leaves the issue underdetermined, so it does not count an unanswered witness or broken-link verse without the required quotation.
